args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) in round_money

src/money.py used ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring claiming banker's
rounding per FIN-212. This caused tests/test_money.py to fail in the
nightly build (2.665 rounding to 2.67 instead of 2.66).

Switch the rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so the implementation
matches the documented behavior and the tests pass.

args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py::round_money` claimed banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212) in its docstring but actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`.
- This caused `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` to fail in the nightly build, since `Decimal("2.665")` rounded up to `2.67` instead of `2.66`.

## Fix
- Changed the rounding mode passed to `Decimal.quantize` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so the implementation matches the documented FIN-212 behavior.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed (all tests green).
